driveOwnershipProof.step2: Read one or more explicitly related Skin records for that heroId from the frozen Skin relation/inventory.
driveOwnershipProof.step3: Derive the runtime skin stem only by stripping the literal _Prefab.prefab suffix from an explicit sourceSpinePath basename; do not normalize spelling.
driveOwnershipProof.step4: A structured Drive Hero folder is owned by that heroId only when a non-basic skin descendant contains an image/png whose filename begins with the exact runtime skin stem followed by an underscore.
driveOwnershipProof.step5: The exact matched Skin asset must be unique to that heroId under the frozen Skin relation; collision or multiple Hero ownership is REVIEW.
driveOwnershipProof.step6: After folder ownership is proven, use the sibling structural folder titled exactly 기본 only as a role locator, never as Hero identity evidence.

basePortraitSelection.note: Filename structure selects a file role only after folder ownership is proven; it never proves Hero ownership.
